## UI

| ID | Requirement | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UI-1 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show input fields for the serial connection options: baud rate, data bits, parity, stop bits and flow control | ✅ Tested | 3 tests; Browser side: baud rate, data bits, parity, stop bits and flow control inputs in the cell header, checked in the Claude desktop browser pane (Chromium). |
| UI-2 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show input fields that allow filtering the ports offered by USB vendor and product ID | ✅ Tested | 3 tests |
| UI-3 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show a button that triggers the browser's serial port selector | 👀 Reviewed | Connect calls navigator.serial.requestPort. Checked in the Claude desktop browser pane with a mocked navigator.serial, not yet with a real device. |
| UI-4 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall pass the user provided connection options and filters to the browser's Web Serial functionality | ✅ Tested | 1 test; The USB filter is passed as requestPort({filters}) and the options as port.open({baudRate, dataBits, stopBits, parity, flowControl}). Checked in the Claude desktop browser pane with a mocked navigator.serial. |
| UI-5 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show if a serial port is connected | ✅ Tested | 4 tests |
| UI-6 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show information about the connected serial port | ✅ Tested | 2 tests |
| UI-7 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show the data received from the serial port | ✅ Tested | 3 tests |
| UI-8 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show UI to allow sending data to the serial port as text or hex, with an optional line ending | ✅ Tested | 4 tests |
| UI-9 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall show the data sent to the serial port | ✅ Tested | 2 tests |
| UI-10 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall allow showing the sent and received data as text or as hex | ✅ Tested | 1 test |
| UI-11 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall allow clearing the shown data | ✅ Tested | 1 test |
| UI-12 | When the user clicks Disconnect, the KinoWebSerial UI shall close the serial port | ✅ Tested | 1 test; Browser side: Disconnect cancels the reader, releases the writer and closes the port. Checked with a mocked SerialPort that refuses to close locked streams. |
| UI-13 | If reading from the serial port fails, then the KinoWebSerial UI shall show the error | ✅ Tested | 1 test; Browser side: read errors are reported and reading resumes on the new readable stream; a lost device is reported and disconnects. Checked with a mocked SerialPort. |
| UI-14 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall persist user input as part of the Livebook | ✅ Tested | 8 tests |
| UI-15 | The KinoWebSerial UI shall match the UX/UI of the official Kino Smart Cells | 👀 Reviewed | Header, inputs and colors follow kino_db's Smart Cells (shared with kino_web_bluetooth). Compared visually with screenshots, not yet inside Livebook. |

## Programmatic API

| ID | Requirement | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| API-1 | The KinoWebSerial API shall have the same functionality as the UI except where the browser requires direct user input | ✅ Tested | 10 tests; UI features and their API: connected status and port info (connected?/1, info/1), received data (subscribe/1, stream/1, lines/1), sending (write/3, write_async/2), disconnect (disconnect/1). Text/hex display and clearing are views of the same data. Only picking a port needs the UI. |
| API-2 | The KinoWebSerial API shall allow subscribing to async data received by the GenServer representing the serial port | ✅ Tested | 5 tests |
| API-3 | The KinoWebSerial API shall allow sync and async writes to the GenServer representing the serial port | ✅ Tested | 9 tests |
| API-4 | The KinoWebSerial API shall allow setting the DTR, RTS and break control signals and reading the CTS, DSR, DCD and RI status signals | ✅ Tested | 6 tests |
| API-5 | The KinoWebSerial API shall allow consuming received data as a stream of chunks or of lines | ✅ Tested | 4 tests |
